body: Chennai-based; portfolio in Dolly Khanna's name has been run by her husband Rajiv Khanna and active since 1996. Style: bottom-up, small/micro-cap, small stakes, frequent churn, in unglamorous 'old economy' sectors - textiles, sugar, chemicals, manufacturing, petro/refining, aquaculture. Past holdings cited in media include Rain Industries (stake trimmed 2022), Nilkamal, Thirumalai Chemicals and Avanti Feeds (not verified holding-by-holding here); in the March 2026 quarter she added Chennai Petroleum and Sharda Cropchem. Portfolio value estimates conflict: ~Rs 226.6 crore (5paisa, Jan 2026) vs >Rs 485 crore across 12 stocks (Business Today, Apr 2026) - different dates and methods. Edge: process - buying cyclicals when they are unloved (low P/B, trough margins, sector pessimism) and exiting as the cycle matures; small size lets her trade micro caps. No audited track record; 'multibagger' claims in media are anecdotal. Mistakes: holdings in commodity names can give back gains in the down-cycle; the high churn makes static cloning dangerous. Copyable: a cyclical playbook - buy when industry capacity is shutting, margins are at trough and P/B is near historic lows; sell into peak margins and capacity announcements - not her disclosed tickers.
title: Dolly Khanna (Rajiv Khanna) - unloved old-economy cyclicals (India)
